en.text: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦回到会幕门口，到摩西那里，瘟疫已经止住了。

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫回到會幕門口，到摩西那裏，瘟疫已經止住了。
